name: Navigator
note: Size not printed (a Human strain, p.11). No maximums printed (the p.18 table has no Navigator column): Human maximums by GM ruling (docs/rules-flow.md §11.27). No Species Keywords printed; the Navigator archetype (p.119) carries IMPERIUM, NAVIS NOBILITE, [HOUSE], PSYKER. Mutant reads "IMPERIAL characters" as printed (the keyword is IMPERIUM).

abilities.name: Mutant
abilities.text: +2DN to all Interaction tests with IMPERIAL characters.

abilities.name: Warp Eye
abilities.text: You are considered to be a PSYKER, though you may only select Navigator powers. When you use Psyniscience, double the range for each Exalted Icon shifted. Further, you cannot gain Corruption from looking into or being exposed to the Warp.

abilities.name: Hereditary Mutations
abilities.text: Your form has been twisted and distorted by exposure to the Immaterium and by generations of inbreeding. Choose one of your attributes; any skill tests using that attribute suffer +1DN, and any derived traits from that attribute are reduced by 1.

name: Beastman
note: Maximums from the table on p.18. Size not printed ("slightly taller and broader than the average human", p.14). No Species Keywords printed. Child of Chaos's +3 Corruption has no structured field on a Rule (Mods has no corruption).

abilities.name: Reviled Abhuman
abilities.text: +2DN to all Interaction tests with characters who do not possess the CHAOS keyword.

abilities.name: Horns
abilities.text: You may make melee attacks with your horns ([S]+5 +2ED / AP –). Thus, you are always armed.

abilities.name: Bestial Savagery
abilities.text: +1d to all Intimidation tests.

abilities.name: Child of Chaos
abilities.text: You begin play with +3 corruption.

name: Shas T’au
note: Fire Caste. Maximums from the table on p.18. Size not printed. No Species Keywords printed; T'AU by GM ruling (docs/rules-flow.md §11.19). "In game terms, each Caste is a different species; a Shas T’au cannot choose an archetype for Fio T’au, and vice versa" (p.15).

abilities.name: For the Greater Good (Shas)
abilities.text: When you assist an ally using Awareness, Ballistic Skill, or Stealth, you may halve the number of dice you would add and add that many Icons to the test you are assisting.

abilities.name: Dull Soul
abilities.text: You cannot gain the PSYKER keyword under any circumstances.

name: Fio T’au
note: Earth Caste. Maximums from the table on p.18. Size not printed ("especially short and broad", p.17). No Species Keywords printed; T'AU by GM ruling (docs/rules-flow.md §11.19).

abilities.name: For the Greater Good (Fio)
abilities.text: When you assist an ally using Medicae, Scholar, or Tech, you may halve the number of dice you would add and add that many Icons to the test you are assisting.

abilities.name: Dull Soul
abilities.text: You cannot gain the PSYKER keyword under any circumstances.

name: Kor T’au
note: Air Caste. Maximums from the table on p.18. Size not printed. No Species Keywords printed; T'AU by GM ruling (docs/rules-flow.md §11.19).

abilities.name: For the Greater Good (Kor)
abilities.text: When you assist an ally using Awareness, Pilot, or Tech, you may halve the number of dice you would add and add that many Icons to the test you are assisting.

abilities.name: Grav-Adapted
abilities.text: You ignore all DN increases for high, low, or zero-gravity, and you gain a Flying Speed equal to your normal Speed when in zero gravity.

abilities.name: Dull Soul
abilities.text: You cannot gain the PSYKER keyword under any circumstances.

name: Por T’au
note: Water Caste. Maximums from the table on p.18. Size not printed. No Species Keywords printed; T'AU by GM ruling (docs/rules-flow.md §11.19).

abilities.name: For the Greater Good (Por)
abilities.text: When you assist an ally using Cunning, Deception, or Persuasion, you may halve the number of dice you would add and add that many Icons to the test you are assisting.

abilities.name: Polyglot
abilities.text: You know additional languages equal to your Scholar rank. When you encounter an unfamiliar language, you gain +Double Rank on Scholar tests to learn or translate that language.

abilities.name: Dull Soul
abilities.text: You cannot gain the PSYKER keyword under any circumstances.

name: Aun T’au
note: Ethereal Caste. Maximums from the table on p.18. Size not printed. No Species Keywords printed; T'AU by GM ruling (docs/rules-flow.md §11.19).

abilities.name: Ethereal Presence
abilities.text: T’AU characters within 12m always add bonus dice equal to twice the Ethereal’s Rank to their Resolve and Conviction tests. T’AU characters cannot willingly harm an Ethereal and must pass a DN 5 Resolve test or become Pinned if their actions allow an Ethereal to be harmed.

abilities.name: Dull Soul
abilities.text: You cannot gain the PSYKER keyword under any circumstances.

name: Asuryani Ghost Warrior
note: Maximums from the table on p.18. Size not printed (the body is "exactly 10 feet tall"). No Species Keywords printed; Wraithsight makes it a PSYKER.

abilities.name: Aeldari
abilities.text: You may select talents which have a prerequisite of Aeldari species.

abilities.name: Undead
abilities.text: You are immune to effects which would stun or knock out other foes. You can never suffer Shock damage. However, you are distant and disconnected from mortal existence, and thus can never generate Glory.

abilities.name: Wraithbone Form
abilities.text: Your robotic body is extremely resistant to harm. Your body naturally has an Armour Rating of 5. In addition, your Determination increases by +3d, and you are immune to the Bleeding, Exhausted, and Poisoned conditions, and cannot suffocate. You are healed using the Tech skill instead of Medicae.

abilities.name: Wraithsight
abilities.text: A Ghost Warrior is a PSYKER, but may not purchase any psychic powers, not even Smite. Further, you are immune to any penalties or hindrances to vision from any source other than the Warp. However, whenever you roll a Complication on any Test, you become Blinded as the Warp clouds your vision. This can only be removed by a DN 8 Willpower test as a Combat Action, or by an ASURYANI PSYKER within 10m succeeding on a DN 4 Leadership (Wil) Test.

name: Custodian
note: Maximums from the table on p.18. Size not printed. No Species Keywords printed.

abilities.name: Aegis of the Emperor
abilities.text: A Custodian may roll Determination against Mortal Wounds.

abilities.name: Indomitable, Incorruptible
abilities.text: You add +2 to your Resolve, and you automatically succeed on all Corruption Tests. Your Maximum Wounds are increased by +4.

abilities.name: Solitary
abilities.text: A Custodian maintains a unique pool of Glory. They may save up to 3 points of Glory, and they cannot save points into the group pool, nor can they spend Glory generated by anyone else.

abilities.name: Despised by the Unholy
abilities.text: If a Custodian is present in a game, the GM’s starting and maximum Ruin are increased by 1.

name: Kin
note: Maximums from the table on p.18 (shared by Kin and Ironkin). Size not printed ("a little over four feet tall"). Cloneskein Traits are the option group kin-cloneskein-traits.

abilities.name: Shrouded Soul
abilities.text: Your Conviction increases by +2.

abilities.name: Kin-Bond
abilities.text: On any Interaction-based skill test with another member of your own Kindred, gain +2 bonus dice.

abilities.name: Cloneskein
abilities.text: Kin receive the ABHUMAN keyword. In addition, each Kin may select a single Cloneskein Trait from the list below.

name: Ironkin
note: Maximums from the table on p.18 (shared by Kin and Ironkin). Size not printed.

abilities.name: Cerebral Unit
abilities.text: Your Conviction increases by +2. Further, if you are slain, your Cerebral Unit (CU) can be retrieved and a new body built for you.

abilities.name: Synthetic Emotion
abilities.text: You increase the DN of any interaction-based skill test with any character who lacks the LEAGUES OF VOTANN keyword by +1.

abilities.name: Machine
abilities.text: Ironkin receive the ROBOT keyword. You are immune to the Bleeding and Poisoned conditions and cannot suffocate. You are healed using the Tech skill instead of Medicae.
